title: Legacy single-argument lock and timer overloads key by token alone, a second key space that does not exclude the chain:token keys

evidence.note: tryAcquireSellLock / releaseSellLock: one argument gives key token.toLowerCase(), two arguments give chain:token
registerStopLoss, registerTakeProfit, registerTimedSell keep legacy (token, handle) overloads
clearAllTimersForToken has the same dual keying

every caller at the base SHA uses the two-argument form (exitEngine.ts :669, :832, :1169, :1483, :1590; exitTrigger.ts:240; controls.ts:92, :167); registerStopLoss/TakeProfit/TimedSell have no callers

sibling_sites_checked: All overloads in exitManager.ts and every caller in src/ and scripts/ at the base SHA (command evidence). tryEnqueuePosition and hasExitMonitorTimer are two-argument only.
severity_rationale: S4: latent, no caller uses the legacy form today. A future caller using it would not exclude a chain-keyed exit of the same token (a double sell). The three registrars are dead code.
recommendation: Delete the single-argument overloads and the three dead registrars (Phase 25 audited dead-code removal). No behaviour change, so no card.
